decisions.reason: The inertial sensor module sits close to the core building-block system and gained visibility with its own page in 2024, so it meets aspirations at low carrying cost in a growing firm with slack.
The industrial AC input module has had its own page and an explicit launch announcement in both years, which signals it performs at or above aspiration within the modular platform.

Although only mentioned rather than featured, the solid state relay module is a low-cost extension of established offerings that the expanding firm's slack can easily carry, so no problemistic search is triggered.
The newly launched LED control module needs time before its results can be judged against aspiration, and its low incremental cost within the brick ecosystem lets the firm keep it while it matures.
The wallbox remote access service supports the firm's strategic expansion in charging and energy management, so management will carry it despite uncertain early results.
